description: Booked nights and the open date ranges a stay can actually be booked in, with minimum-stay rules applied. bookableFrom is the first check-in a request made now may ask for (later than today when the host requires notice before check-in). bookableUntil is the first night the host's booking window has not opened yet (24 months from today when the host has not set one); nights after it are not open rather than taken. The listing's maxNights is the longest stay a quote accepts. Defaults to the next 90 days; at most 365 days per call. Ranges are check-in inclusive, check-out exclusive.

from.description: First date to check, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

to.description: Day after the last date to check, YYYY-MM-DD.
